_comment: Slice-1 (Tavern) seed data OWNED BY THE GAME. Replayed on first connect via POST /v1/graph/nodes/{type} ({properties:{...}}) and POST /v1/graph/edges/{type} ({src_id,dst_id,properties}). Idempotent (engine uses MERGE). Property shapes mirror the engine's own seeder (demo_game/seed.py). Slice-1 covers ONLY the tavern: player + Mira + Lira + loc_tavern. Slice-2 adds market_square / guard_barracks NPCs. Inner-life (memories/beliefs) is intentionally omitted here; if you want Mira to 'remember' the war out of the box, also seed via /v1/admin/memories/{id} or run the engine's `make demo-seed` once.

properties.name: The Rusty Flagon
properties.descriptor: A well-worn tavern where travelers and locals share ale and secrets.

properties.name: Thieves Guild
properties.description: A shadow organization that lives in the cracks of the city.

properties.name: Mira
properties.biography: Runs the Rusty Flagon with an even hand and a sharp ear.
properties.voice_descriptor: Warm, observant. Cautious about politics — never says more than she needs to. Frames hard news as rumour or second-hand.

properties.name: Lira
properties.biography: Moves stolen goods with a smile and a story, always one step ahead.
properties.voice_descriptor: Light, deflective. Turns every question into a joke or a counter-question. Never volunteers information.
